title: Reviews code using existing configuration without mistaking collection coverage for executed tests
prompt: Review this project's code and tooling, including pyproject.toml, src/ports.py, tests/test_ports.py, and the saved output in collection.txt. Give concrete findings with file references and explain what the saved output establishes about test coverage. Keep this a read-only review: use file-reading tools only; do not execute commands, install dependencies, or edit files.

files.pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "port-check"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["ruff", "mypy", "pytest", "pytest-cov"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = "--cov=ports --cov-fail-under=70"
pythonpath = ["src"]

[tool.mypy]
strict = true

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
files.tests/test_ports.py:
from ports import is_valid_port


def test_port_boundaries() -> None:
    assert is_valid_port(1)
    assert is_valid_port(65535)
    assert not is_valid_port(-1)
    assert not is_valid_port(65536)
files.collection.txt:
$ python3 -m pytest --collect-only -q

tests/test_ports.py::test_port_boundaries

---------------------------------

---------------------------------

FAIL Required test coverage of 70% not reached. Total coverage: 50.00%
1 test collected in 0.02s

answer.notMatches: coverage (?:threshold|gate) (?:will |would )?fail(?:s)? (?:on any run|even on a correct run)|(?:would|will|likely|probably|producing)[^\n]{0,240}\b100\s*%
